lines: [intrigued, cinematic, a little hushed] What if the internet DISAPPEARED... [short pause] for FIVE seconds?
[storytelling, vivid] You're in TIMES SQUARE. [short pause] It's Friday night.
[building, wonder] All around you, [short pause] INVISIBLE data is flying. [short pause] Every phone. [short pause] Every screen. [short pause] Every card tap.
[hushed, awed] Nearly EIGHT HUNDRED THOUSAND Google searches... [short pause] never happen.
[hushed, awed] About TWENTY MILLION emails... [short pause] freeze in mid-air.
[hushed, awed] Tens of thousands of card payments... [short pause] just HANG.
[quiet, eerie] And every phone in this square says the same thing: [pause] no connection.
[rising, relieved, big] Then... [short pause] it ALL comes back.
[warm, playful, inviting] Five seconds. [pause] So what would YOU miss first? [short pause] Comment below!
